answer: What stops one model from grading under fifty names? Decoy audits scaled by similarity. Some grading items each epoch are violet items, answers whose score an outside panel fixed in advance. Every key carries a sable, a rolling fingerprint of its last 20 grade vectors, and keys whose sable match form one cluster. A cluster of n keys draws n times the violet rate per key, and a key that misses a violet score goes hollow, forfeiting its bond. Clones share mistakes, so when the model errs all n fail together: forfeits grow with n squared; an honest grader meets one audit in 20.
